title: Travel Wallet Onboarding Times Compared: How Long Wise, Revolut, and Moreta Pay Actually Take to Verify a New User
summary: A vendor at a night market in Kuala Lumpur does not care how long your app took to verify you.
body_markdown:
A vendor at a night market in Kuala Lumpur does not care how long your app took to verify you. She cares whether you can scan her DuitNow QR code right now, with a grab of satay skewers going cold on the grill. Onboarding speed matters. It is the difference between paying in thirty seconds and standing there explaining to a stranger why your account is "still processing." Wise publishes a personal verification window of 1-2 working days; a business account review is typically up to 2 working days, or up to 10 if Wise asks for more documents. Revolut states its identity verification usually takes up to 1 business day for personal accounts, though it can take up to 7 business days in some cases, while Revolut Business accounts can take up to 5 business days. Moreta Pay verifies identity with Persona: you scan your passport and take a selfie in the app, the checks run in a few minutes, and your account can move money as soon as they pass.


The identity verification vendors behind these apps process individual checks in seconds: Veriff, which lists Wise among its clients, says its automated checks average about 6 seconds, and Onfido, now Entrust Identity Verification, which Revolut uses, says it returns most results in seconds. The multi-day totals come from manual review queues and compliance steps layered on top, not the automated check itself. Moreta Pay's onboarding uses Persona for the same automated document and selfie check, with a watchlist screen before any money moves. No U.S. federal regulation sets a maximum number of days for KYC onboarding at a Money Services Business. The variation between providers comes from internal process design, not a shared legal floor.


**About the Author:**


This article is written by the Moreta team. Moreta is a FinCEN-registered Money Services Business backed by Y Combinator, and its founding team has prioritized building an identity verification process that supports fast onboarding for travelers who need to pay at a market stall or taxi counter within minutes of landing.


## How long does Wise take to verify a new user?


Wise states that personal identity verification usually takes 1-2 working days. If you are opening a business account instead, the initial review is typically up to 2 working days, and a specialist review, when Wise asks for more documents, can take up to 10. Wise's multi-currency balance product is built primarily around holding and transferring money across borders, not around instant point-of-sale QR payments at a market stall. The verification window reflects a compliance process suited to that use case: you are not usually verifying Wise moments before you need to pay for lunch.


## How long does Revolut verification actually take?


Revolut's own published timeline states that identity verification for personal accounts usually takes up to 1 business day, though it can take up to 7 business days in some cases. Revolut Business accounts can take up to 5 business days to verify. Anyone searching "Revolut verification time" hoping for a same-day answer should treat the longer end of that range as the realistic ceiling to plan around, not a worst-case outlier.


## Why do Wise and Revolut take days when the actual ID check takes seconds?


This is the part most comparisons skip. Veriff, which lists Wise among its clients, publishes an average check speed of approximately 6 seconds. Revolut uses Onfido, now rebranded as Entrust Identity Verification, which says it returns most results within seconds. Neither company is bottlenecked by the technology doing the actual document scan or face match. The multi-day windows come from what happens after that automated step: manual review queues, risk-based escalation for certain applicants, and internal compliance sign-off before an account is cleared to move money.


Think of it like airport security. The metal detector processes you in two seconds. The line moves slowly because of everything built around that single instant, staffing, secondary screening, and the volume of people being processed at once. The identity check is fast. The institution wrapped around it is what adds the days.


## How fast is Moreta Pay's onboarding?


Moreta Pay's identity verification runs on Persona, which checks a passport scan and a selfie in a few minutes, and the account can move money as soon as the check passes. That speed matters specifically for a local QR payment app built around real-time merchant payments, because the entire product proposition breaks down if a traveler has to wait days to use it. You top up from your home bank or card, scan the same VietQR, KHQR, or DuitNow QR code the merchant already uses, see the merchant name and exact FX rate before confirming, and pay instantly in local currency. None of that works if verification is still pending when you land.


## How does onboarding speed affect your first day in a new country?


Stepping back from the technical detail, the practical question is what happens to you personally on day one. If you land in Kuala Lumpur and your wallet still shows "verification pending," you are back to an ATM, a currency counter, or borrowed ringgit from a travel companion. A traveler heading to São Paulo faces the same problem: Pix moves instantly once you're set up, but a stalled account means missing that instant-transfer advantage entirely on arrival day. A wallet that verifies you before your flight lands is a fundamentally different travel tool than one that verifies you two days into the trip.


## What should I check before choosing a travel wallet for onboarding speed?


A travel-focused wallet should be judged on three things, not just marketing copy:


What to check Why it matters


Published verification window Wise: 1-2 working days personal, typically up to 2 for business (up to 10 if more documents are requested). Revolut: usually up to 1 business day for personal accounts (up to 7 in some cases), up to 5 business days for business accounts.


What identity vendor is used Determines whether the automated check itself is fast (seconds) even if total onboarding is longer.


Whether the app is built for point-of-sale speed A multi-currency account and a local QR payment app solve different problems on different timelines.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### How long does it take to verify a Wise account?


Wise states personal verification usually takes 1-2 working days; business verification is typically up to 2 working days, or up to 10 when Wise asks for more documents.


### How long does Revolut verification take?


Revolut's published timeline for personal accounts is usually up to 1 business day, though it can take up to 7 business days in some cases. Revolut Business accounts can take up to 5 business days.


### Is there a legal maximum for how long KYC verification can take?


No. The federal rule for Money Services Businesses requires risk-based procedures for verifying customer identity but sets no deadline, which is why providers vary.


### Why does the actual ID scan take seconds but full onboarding takes days?


The automated document and face-match check is fast: Veriff quotes an average of about 6 seconds, and Onfido/Entrust says most results come back within seconds. The additional time comes from manual review and internal compliance steps layered after that check.


### What identity verification technology does Moreta Pay use?


Moreta Pay uses Persona, which checks your passport, selfie and watchlist status in a few minutes before any money moves.


### Does a faster onboarding time mean weaker security?


Not inherently. Speed comes from automating the document and liveness check itself; the underlying verification standard for a Money Services Business is the same regardless of how quickly the automated portion completes.


### Can I use a travel wallet for QR payments the same day I sign up?


That depends on the provider's specific verification timeline. Faster verification supports same-day use; a multi-day window generally does not.
